name: dialogue
character: How the music gets out of the way of speech: the voice chain, the bed level, the band that is carved, the duck that follows the speech mask, the swell into a hit, and the loudness difference the gate audits.
sources: https://aes.org/publications/elibrary-page/20711.pdf (preferred background ducking levels: German public-broadcaster guidance at least 7 LU, typically 16-23 LU; non-experts prefer about 4 LU more than experts)

https://www.cnam.ie/app/uploads/2023/06/20230619_Investigating-a-Standardised-Approach-to-Setting-Audio-Description-Dip-Values_vFINAL-1.pdf (dialogue over music observed at -14 to -17 LU in broadcast; 12-18 dB working range)
https://openclip.app/learn/audio-ducking (duck depth 15-25 dB, attack 10-30 ms, release 200-500 ms)
references/mixing/mix-rules.md (voice-over contract: -8 to -14 dB duck, 25 ms attack, 250-350 ms release)

provenance.intelligibility_band_hz: starting value: the consonant band that carries meaning is about 1-4 kHz
provenance.snr_min_db: inside the observed -14..-17 LU broadcast range and the 12-18 dB working range
provenance.band_min_db: starting value: how far the 1-4 kHz music energy must sit under the voice
